title: Ys X: Proud Nordics
description:
An expanded edition of Ys X: Nordics with quality-of-life improvements, additional story content around Öland Island, new characters, and the Muspelheim challenge dungeon.

Adol Christin and Karja Balta continue their seafaring journey across the Obelia Gulf. The Proud Nordics edition adds new story material centered on Öland Island and additional characters. Political friction, ancient powers and personal development drive the adventure forward. The sea, islands and Nordic-inspired setting define the identity of the world and its pacing.

faq.q: Is this the same as the original Ys X?
faq.a: No. It is an expanded Switch 2 edition with extra content and enhancements.

faq.q: What type of RPG is it?
faq.a: It is a fast-paced action RPG with exploration and strong story momentum.

faq.q: Why is the Switch 2 version notable?
faq.a: It offers stronger performance options and additional content.
Yes. Falcom music is a major highlight of the package.

verdictSummary: A feature-rich monster-raising RPG with strong presentation and customization, though Switch 2 performance is less stable than the hardware can ideally deliver.
verdictCons: Switch 2 frame rate is unlocked and often sits around 30-45 FPS in large areas
Portable mode can dip more often in demanding scenes
